test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is by observing the alphabetical position shifts from the letters of the first cluster to the corresponding letters of the second cluster.

Option (1) 'TL – BV':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4870b9cd9c909a413df5bf8cec5a55ce08f575086bb1d7635b84627f2044a79.png] 

Option (2) 'ZR – HB':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eef2d1e3e609a7840e03ebf7f49a8225ee8e75543ac762b838eb7c1e7a95c7a6.png] 

**Option (3) 'GY – OJ':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05e4f3aed9e1134f8ef3338a5742ed5da8c7a579b154824fed9ad4c8b9e764cf.png] 

Option (4) 'PH – XR':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc1e21fa575c3bd4a05a3422170a79857d6507f405d2d5bdbc3f1efa9d9ce046.png] 

In options 1, 2, and 4, the first letter of the cluster pair moves +8 positions forward and the second letter moves +10 positions forward.

In option 3, the first letter moves +8 positions forward, but the second letter moves +11 positions forward.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
